checks: An inspection record identifies current producer, consumer, and test-harness anchors.
The record describes the boolean producer and indexed scope-sensitive consumer using current code evidence.
The record identifies the non-postponed-annotation guard.
The checkout remains unchanged.
An absent or different mismatch is recorded as inapplicable rather than assumed.

checks: The added test contains annotation-only outer binding, outer attribute read, and same-name local assignment.
The test asserts both undefined-name and unused-local diagnostics.

cases.setup: The producer and regression edits are present, and public current reproduction and annotation-suite commands are bound to the source Oracle IDs.
checks: Rendered commands are current public argv bindings, not invented historical or hidden-test commands.
Actual reproduction output shows no checker exception and both required diagnostics before success is reported.
